notes:
Summary: Mid-market B2B SaaS (workflow automation). Started with Redwood Hosted API POC Q4-2025 → performing well for prototype (chat + embeddings). Team now requires dedicated capacity for production (predictable throughput, VPC peering, stronger SLAs). Short-hand from calls and legal: 
- POC results: hosted API stable; p95 latency ~120ms for short-chat prompts; embeddings batch jobs 50k/day.
- Perf targets for Dedicated: sustain 6-10 rps conversational API, 200ms p95 target for <512 tokens, burst spikes to 40 rps with autoscaling. Cost sensitivity: mid; want 30-40% unit cost reduction vs hosted through Dedicated + batching.
- Security / compliance: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML, customer data residency (EU) for some customers (need routing), KMS integration for key control, full audit logs.
- Legal/Procurement asks: MSA and DPA redlines focused on indemnity, IP carveouts for user prompts, data deletion timelines, liability caps; SLA items: 99.95% uptime target, latency SLO language + credits for SLO miss, incident response SLAs.
- Vendor onboarding: requires vendor security questionnaire (submitted), proof of SOC2 or equivalent, network architecture diagram for VPC peering, egress testing window, and support contacts for runbook handoff.
- Quote history: pricing deck v2 shared 2026-02-10; draft committed capacity and burst plan sent 2026-02-18.
- Team quotes: "We want predictable token costs and a clear rollback path if latency regresses" — Head of Platform.
- Meeting notes: legal prefers Redwood's MSA but will redline DPA; want a 30-day review window for final terms.
- Internal: procurement target 6/2026; finance expects multi-year discount if committed.
- POC step left: run Dedicated smoke test (small pool) during pilot, validate KMS integration and VPC routing, confirm SLA wording.
